title: Phishing Trip
speakerNotes:
- Introduce Phishing Trip and Hook, the calm fish companion
- Purpose: less effort checking a travel number before calling; no safety promise
- Hook art: hook-figma layers composed per stillwater-mobile/components/hookArt.ts
- Sources: replit.md; artifacts/stillwater-mobile/README.md; components/Hook.tsx

title: Travelers in distress have no time to fact-check everything
speakerNotes:
- Scenario is illustrative, not research or a real testimonial
- Disrupted flight, changed hotel, unfamiliar support number
- Sources: replit.md (product purpose)

title: Evidence in one place
speakerNotes:
- Right side is a labeled UI illustration, not live results; no real number shown
- Published-contact match shows source and review/expiry dates; caller identity stays unknown
- Hook reacts to check state; no runtime AI verdict
- No reputation data is used
- Sources: stillwater-mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx; components/Hook.tsx

title: Three places to turn
description: Check, Directory, My Trips, and the extension
speakerNotes:
- Mobile tabs: Check, Directory, My Trips
- Extension is separate: Chrome/Edge source plus Safari resources
- Safari packaging, signing, device validation still required; mobile cannot inspect Safari
- Sources: index.tsx, directory.tsx, trips.tsx; extensions/stillwater/README.md

title: A deliberate three-step journey
speakerNotes:
- Selecting a number only prefills; a tap submits the check
- The app never places calls automatically
- Sources: stillwater-mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx, directory.tsx

title: APIs with distinct jobs
description: Mobile/extension to Express API to PostgreSQL, with optional providers
speakerNotes:
- Google Places API (New) Text Search: direct HTTPS implementation exists; live access not verified; needs config, billing, key restrictions
- Outbound limit: 10 attempts/day shared only via the same counter DB; not a dollar cap
- Twilio Lookup v2 Basic: optional, disabled by default, validity/format metadata only, no ownership evidence
- No scam-report API, no runtime LLM API
- Sources: api-server/README.md; src/verification/places.ts, twilio.ts; docs/google-places-search.md

title: Built together in Replit
speakerNotes:
- Agent-assisted development with task iteration
- Shared workspace; Expo and API previews; PostgreSQL; test/build workflows
- No production deployment and no measured speed claim
- AI assisted development only, not runtime verdicts
- Sources: replit.md

title: Trust includes uncertainty
speakerNotes:
- Official-source match is not a safety guarantee; unknown is not fraud
- No persisted submitted-check history (not a promise of zero transient processing or caching); My Trips stores curated company IDs, not bookings
- My Trips fetches sources fresh; no offline assurance
- Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, Safari approval unverified
- Sources: stillwater-mobile/README.md; trips.tsx; api-server/README.md

title: Less time fact-checking. More attention for your trip.
speakerNotes:
- Benefit is the purpose, not a measured impact
- Demo: pick a number, inspect the evidence, decide the next step
- Sources: replit.md; stillwater-mobile/README.md
